title: Nixon on whether the CIA conspired to remove him
summary: Richard Nixon tells of Nixon on whether the CIA conspired to remove him, about 1972-1974 at Washington, D.C., and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I don't know uh I know many people think so uh I would would say that I've had it found it difficult to understand why the CIA which apparently had Advanced knowledge of the break-in uh didn't inform me

plain: Richard Nixon, the US president who left office in 1974 over the Watergate scandal, which began with a break-in at his opponents' offices in Washington, was asked whether the CIA, America's foreign intelligence agency, plotted to bring him down. In the clip, Nixon says he does not know, that many people think so, and that he found it hard to understand why the CIA, which apparently knew about the break-in in advance, did not tell him. If true, it would mean the intelligence agency had a hand in the fall of a president.
